mission: Help a parent or student choose a suitable Shinkyokushinkai hall and contact the correct instructor with trustworthy information and minimal friction.
north_star: A visitor can go from landing on the site to a correct direct instructor contact for a suitable hall without needing another intermediary.
stakeholder_outcomes: Visitors quickly understand the offer and age threshold.
Visitors can find halls by city, day, address, school or instructor.
Visitors can share a filtered hall/instructor URL and recover the same state later.
Federation information and trainer identity remain source-bound and conservative.
The maintainer can distinguish source health, release health and production health from machine-readable evidence.
target_capabilities: real federation media and photo reports
machine-readable project state and problem registry

strengths.claim: Recruitment data and identity constraints are regression guarded.
strengths.evidence: scripts/verify.mjs checks the 18 halls, 11 instructors, media provenance and trainer identity rules.

strengths.claim: The runtime can be shipped as one self-contained HTML artifact.
strengths.evidence: scripts/build-static.mjs inlines the project CSS/JS and the release contract rejects local runtime dependencies and loader fallbacks.

strengths.claim: The public production failure mode that used p0.bin..p4.bin reconstruction has been removed.
strengths.evidence: Vercel production deployment dpl_2k1x8VbTGQtisfTptmeUzfafJane built a 115467-byte direct self-contained HTML release and the public domain returned that HTML.

tradeoffs.choice: Keep a static zero-runtime-dependency application instead of introducing a framework/backend.
tradeoffs.benefit: Small attack surface, simple hosting, fast first response and deterministic artifact generation.
tradeoffs.cost: No server-owned form workflow, analytics pipeline or dynamic content management is provided by the application itself.

tradeoffs.choice: Use conservative identity fallbacks when a trainer portrait is not source-bound.
tradeoffs.benefit: Avoids publishing a wrong person's image.
tradeoffs.cost: Some trainer cards remain less visually rich until a verified source is available.

accepted_debt.debt: The Vercel project is not Git-linked and unattended GitHub-to-Vercel deployment still depends on a repository VERCEL_TOKEN secret being available.
accepted_debt.why_accepted_now: Production can be recovered through authenticated Vercel OAuth while the source pipeline fails closed instead of silently serving a stale build.
accepted_debt.exit_condition: A push to project/kyokushin-nn completes verify -> Vercel production deploy -> exact-release public smoke without manual intervention.

accepted_debt.debt: The current execution container cannot complete Chromium screenshot QA because Chromium hangs in its D-Bus/zygote environment.
accepted_debt.why_accepted_now: HTTP production evidence and deterministic source/release checks prove the delivery incident independently of that test environment.
accepted_debt.exit_condition: A normal browser-capable runner executes responsive visual/runtime QA against the exact production release.

next_demonstrable_increment.outcome: Make every production release attributable to one exact Git commit and prove that exact release on the public domain.
acceptance: dist/health.json exposes the same release identity
production-smoke rejects a stale release when KYOKUSHIN_EXPECTED_RELEASE is set
CI artifacts include both index.html and health.json
